email.subject: Trusty Group Plumbing: two quick fixes for Harbor Falls calls
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I looked at Trusty Group Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you calls.

First, there's no click-to-call on mobile. Most plumbing searches happen on a phone when something's leaking right now, and if people have to copy a number instead of tapping it, a chunk just move to the next result.

Second, your page title doesn't lead with "plumber" or "Harbor Falls," so you're less visible in local search results against competitors who do.

Both are quick, inexpensive fixes. Happy to walk you through exactly what I'd change in a free 10-minute call, no obligation.

Worth a short chat this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
